description: This file defines the LessThanOperator class, which implements a comparison operator that checks if a value is less than a specified threshold. It is part of the JSON API filter operators for the SuiteCRM project, specifically within the comparators namespace.

classes.name: LessThanOperator
classes.description: A class representing the 'less than' comparison operator for filtering JSON API requests within SuiteCRM, supporting conversion to filter tags and SQL operators, as well as validation logic.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator string 'lt' for less than comparison.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator string '<' for less than comparison.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether the provided operator is a string and whether it is valid as per parent class logic.
